title: feat: add Pollinations harness and MCP client for Hermes Agent
author: alkonsafe
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15543

Adds `polli harness hermes on|off|status` and the Hermes Agent client for `polli mcp`.

- `on` registers a named `pollinations` provider in `$HERMES_HOME/config.yaml` (`api`, `key_env`), stores a dedicated key in `$HERMES_HOME/.env` as `POLLI_HERMES_API_KEY`, and installs the Polli skill under `skills/polli/`. Hermes discovers the live Pollinations models from the endpoint, so there is no second model catalog; pick the default with `--model` (default `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`) and switch later with `hermes model`.
- `status` reports `installed`, `configured`, and the selected `model`.
- `off` restores the previous files byte-for-byte, or strips only the Pollinations provider/key/model/skill when the files changed since `on`; it also removes the now-empty skill directory. Other providers, fallbacks, memories, and skills stay untouched.
- `polli mcp install|remove|status hermes` writes `mcp_servers` in `config.yaml`, preserving comments and unrelated entries.
- Docs updated: `CODING_HARNESSES.md`, `packages/polli-cli/README.md`, `packages/polli-cli/SKILL.md`, root `README.md`.

Verification:

- `polli harness hermes on` -> key `polli-harness-hermes`, `configured: true`, model `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`.
- Real `hermes chat --provider pollinations -m deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash -t terminal --yolo -Q --format stream-json` session made a `terminal` tool call (`echo stream-proof-123`, exit 0) and returned the output; the result event reported token usage.
- `hermes skills list` shows `polli` enabled; existing providers, model fallbacks, memories, and 12 skill categories were preserved.
- `polli mcp install hermes --all` added 6 servers; `hermes mcp test pollinations` connected and discovered 10 tools; `polli mcp remove hermes` removed all 6.
- `polli harness hermes off` -> `outcome: restored`; `config.yaml` and `.env` SHA256 match the pre-`on` hashes.
- Tests: 31 passed (`hermes.test.ts`, `clients.test.ts`); Biome clean; `npm run build` succeeds.

Note:

gist.headline: Hermes joins the garden
gist.blurb: Polli can now set up Hermes Agent with Pollinations models and MCP tools. It can also pack everything away without disturbing the rest of Hermes’s setup.
gist.summary: Added `polli harness hermes on|off|status` to configure a Pollinations provider, key, and skill for Hermes Agent, plus `polli mcp install|remove|status hermes` for MCP servers; the default model is `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`.
gist.impact: Hermes users can discover live Pollinations models, install six MCP servers that expose 10 tools, and remove the integration while preserving unrelated providers, settings, and skills.
gist.visual_concept: Represent Hermes Agent as a friendly retro terminal with a small winged-envelope badge; no project mascot is identified. Polli helps the monitor robot connect six little MCP server pots to the terminal, with ten tool sprouts suggesting the discovered tools.
